name: Meridian Standard Chrome-Last Boot
description:
A no-nonsense, wide-last work boot manufactured to fit the most common prosthetic foot models on the market. The sizing system uses prosthetic model codes rather than conventional shoe sizes — you order by your chrome model number, not your old biological size. Leather upper, steel shank, thick rubber sole. It looks like a plain work boot and functions like one.

Mass-produced and stocked at every Tier 2 hardware and supply depot in GLMZ. The boot of choice for augmented workers who just need something that fits and lasts. Zero fashion intent, complete functional reliability.
functionality: Manufactured to fit standard prosthetic foot model codes. Wide last accommodates most common chrome foot profiles without modification.
what_it_says: You don't have time for fashion. You have a job, you have chrome, you need boots that fit.
worn_by: Tier 2 laborers with standard prosthetic feet
story_hooks: Because they're ordered by prosthetic model code, a pair of Meridian Standards tells you exactly what chrome someone is running — useful or dangerous information depending on context.
An underground modification scene has sprung up around these boots — people customizing the plain shells into something personal.
